bio.text: Carlos Giménez represents Florida's 28th Congressional District, covering Monroe County and part of Miami-Dade County, and was first elected to the U.S. House in 2020.
Born in Cuba in 1954, he joined the City of Miami Fire Department in 1975 and served as its chief before being appointed City of Miami Manager in 2000.
He was elected a Miami-Dade County Commissioner in 2004 and Mayor of Miami-Dade County in 2011, and was re-elected in 2012 and 2016.
He holds a bachelor's degree in public administration from Barry University.
